data.title: XRP Held Flat This Week While Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana Fell. Is It Breaking Away From Bitcoin?
data.description: XRP barely budged this week while Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana tumbled, sparking talk of a long-awaited decoupling. But the correlation data, the ETF flows, and a brutal 30-day track record tell a more complicated story.
